unsupported: Quilter's Corner opened in 2020 in Faulkton, South Dakota, founded by Robin and Lora.
The shop began as a local quilt fabric retailer and quickly added live-streamed shopping events to reach a broader audience.
It also serves as an authorized Janome dealer, stocking models from the Travel Mate, Skyline, and Memory Craft series.

Known for: Weekly live shopping broadcasts since 2020; Quarterly mystery quilt kits (Mystery Five-0); Authorized Janome sewing machine dealer; Three-day catered quilt retreats; Free shipping on orders over $99
